Discover a world full of possibilities. Make your professional dreams come true at Austrian Airlines. You are an excellent communicator

jobs.description: As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.The Com... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks. * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders. * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements. * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data. * With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before. * You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna * Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed * Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry * High level of commitment and team spirit * English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language What to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability * EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).
